### 3. 差异验证（对比聚合结果）
```sql
-- 验证新旧表 item_price 聚合是否一致
SELECT old.env, old.deduct_unique_id, old.ads_id, old.user_id, old.entrance,
    item_price_old, item_price_new
FROM (
    SELECT 'old' as env, deduct_unique_id, ads_id, user_id, entrance,
        SUM(item_price) as item_price_old
    FROM mp_paidads.dwd_advertise_performance_di__reg_s0_live
    WHERE grass_region = 'PH' AND grass_date = date'2026-05-24'
      AND report_type = 1
    GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5
) old
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 'new' as env, deduct_unique_id, ads_id, user_id, entrance,
        SUM(item_price) as item_price_new
    FROM mp_paidads.temp_dwd_event_performance_di__reg_s0_live
    WHERE grass_region = 'PH' AND grass_date = date'2026-05-24'
      AND report_type = 1
    GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5
) new
  ON old.deduct_unique_id = new.deduct_unique_id
    AND old.ads_id = new.ads_id
    AND old.user_id = new.user_id
    AND old.entrance = new.entrance
WHERE ABS(COALESCE(item_price_old,0) - COALESCE(item_price_new,0)) > 0
LIMIT 10
```

### 5. 生产写入（traffic 类型，完整 INSERT 模式）
```sql
INSERT OVERWRITE temp_unify_output_performance_mapping_detail_di
PARTITION (grass_region, grass_date, type)
SELECT
    o.join_key as join_key,
    n.join_key as new_join_key,
    CAST(n.entrance AS string) as entrance_new,
    CAST(o.entrance AS string) as entrance_old,
    CAST(n.ads_id AS string) as ads_id_new,
    CAST(o.ads_id AS string) as ads_id_old,
    -- ... 所有 217 对字段（每对包含 _new / _old）
    upper('${grass_region}') as grass_region,
    date'${grass_date}' as grass_date,
    'traffic' as type
FROM old_performance o
LEFT JOIN new_performance n
  ON n.join_key = o.join_key
```
